start.scenario_load: loaded must be exactly true before start event
start.runtime_identity: sealed relocated base Python and site-packages; first sys.path entries bundle/source/site; module origins must lie under sealed roots

observation.outer_response: official exactly errors/ui/vision; ui_only exactly errors/ui; errors must be empty and ui must be an object

worker_events.ui_transport: controller-owned inherited UI_FD; no worker-selected UI sidecar pathname

finished.failure_sidecars: all nonempty claimed sidecars are path-bound and rehashed for every terminal status; valid_complete requires all five

finalized.mutual_binding: pending canonical result SHA/status/ledger_last_before_final must equal finalized result_sha/status/previous; published inode and hash are rechecked

final_statuses.PASS: all 30 valid_complete and all 30 pair endpoints EXACT
final_statuses.FAIL_PARITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED: all 30 valid_complete and one or more OBSERVED_MISMATCH
final_statuses.INVALID: all cells planned but one or more invalid/unobservable or controller integrity failure after planning
final_statuses.INCOMPLETE: controller ends before all 30 cells are planned/terminal

lifecycle.result_publication: same-directory durable pending file then exclusive atomic hard-link; never direct write to canonical result

ledger_hash_chain.record_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical record including previous_record_sha256 and excluding record_sha256

result.durability: exact canonical bytes written/fsynced to bound same-directory pending path; payload hash appended to finalized ledger; closed ledger validated; os.link publishes complete inode without overwrite; directory fsynced; pending link then removed and directory fsynced

os_sandbox.repository_sidecars: controller copies from ephemeral workdir after child exit
os_sandbox.read_denylist: engine repository; Prime state; .ssh/.aws/.config/.gnupg/.kube/.docker; .netrc/.git-credentials/.npmrc/.pypirc; ~/Library/Keychains; DeepVoice/LG Aimers; original DiscoveryWorld .git and every committed top-level source path (but not its .venv dependencies)
os_sandbox.process: only initial process-exec allowed; process fork/spawn denied by default
os_sandbox.security_scope: fixed sealed single-process worker; fork/spawn/network/external-write denied; sensitive/original engine/runtime roots denied. Hostile concurrent same-UID artifact namespace replacement is detected by retained directory/file FDs before successful return.
os_sandbox.stream_confused_deputy: four controller-created files are copied only after O_NOFOLLOW regular-file device/inode match; no worker path is trusted
os_sandbox.frames: preopened directory FD; path device/inode and each direct regular entry checked with dir_fd and no-follow operations

deadline_semantics: Command is built before the fresh pre-Popen monotonic check; deadline is also checked before PLANNED/setup, immediately after Popen, during wait, and after successful wait. No call occurs when the fresh pre-call sample is expired; a cross-call pause is killed and terminalized.
environment_provenance_limitation: Worker base Python and site-package bytes are content-manifested, copied, and reverified. macOS kernel/dyld/system frameworks and controller interpreter runtime remain the explicit host TCB.
pair_inputs: Each endpoint must be valid_complete and carry ui_hashes, pre_state_hashes, post_state_hashes as exactly 1001 lowercase SHA-256 hex strings; otherwise UNOBSERVABLE.
strong_closure: Rehash every claimed sidecar for every terminal status; every PLANNED cell must be FINISHED; protocol-revalidate valid cells and all pair vectors; pending result canonical/status/previous hash is mutually bound to finalized ledger and published inode.

runtime_content_closure.entries: exact paths, sizes, SHA-256, executable bit; safe relative symlinks only; no hardlinks/special files
runtime_content_closure.execution: copy and verify before marker; worker uses copied interpreter with -I -S -B bootstrap; final full rehash

controller_seal.launcher: stdlib-only launcher reads O_NOFOLLOW regular files once, hashes, fsyncs private copies, writes seal, then execs bootstrap with -I -S -B
controller_seal.validation: module origins and every seal file hash verified before marker

signal_semantics: One race-free outer latch is installed before marker and passed unchanged into managed_run. No production handler handoff occurs. Signals before the blocked outcome-commit clear check dominate non-PASS; later signals remain blocked and are delivered only after mutually bound publication.

approval_gate.execution_root: SHA-256 over exact hashes for runner/lifecycle/protocol/episode/adapter/state/manifest/schemas/launcher/bootstrap/environment module/content manifest
approval_gate.binding: each receipt is byte-bound and must name the exact execution_root_sha256; approval itself remains AWAITING until user acts
approval_gate.authority_root: execution components + exact design SHA + canonical proposal core SHA (proposal excluding derived approval text)
approval_gate.user_authorization: canonical raw authorization receipt must match a sentence derived from run/grid/budget/execution-root/design hash; approval and proposal must contain the same derived sentence
approval_gate.launcher: pins canonical execution component paths/hashes and controller interpreter independently of caller approval; arbitrary approval paths cannot select code
approval_gate.trust_boundary: User authority is established by the parent agent receiving an explicit daemon/API user message. Repository receipts are auditable accidental-execution gates, not signatures against a malicious same-UID agent.
approval_gate.receipt_roots: clean/runtime receipts bind execution_root_sha256; method/handoff receipts bind authority_root_sha256

abort_receipt.semantics: best-effort durable record for post-marker outer exception; absence after marker still means CONSUMED_UNCLOSED_INVALID, never PASS/retry
abort_receipt.precedence: A valid canonical result suppresses abort creation; stdout print failure is non-authoritative and cannot create a contradictory abort.

artifact_namespace.root: pre-opened paper/research/receipts directory FD with retained device/inode
artifact_namespace.directories: created/opened with dir_fd and O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW; retained until result closure
artifact_namespace.files: controller retains every created artifact FD; reads use pread and compare named no-follow inode
artifact_namespace.ledger: single retained FD for all appends and validation
artifact_namespace.protocol: event/UI/frame-manifest validation reads pinned FDs through artifact_reader
artifact_namespace.publication: pending and result use same pinned namespace and inode; any root/file/directory replacement blocks PASS
artifact_namespace.security_scope: prevents worker-controlled pathname substitution and detects namespace drift at validation/publication checkpoints; a malicious concurrent same-UID process after the final check is part of the trusted host boundary, not excluded cryptographically
